name: How To Treat People
overview: Scripture teaches that how we treat others reflects the heart of God's law, as Jesus commands us to do unto others as we would have them do unto us, embodying the essence of the law and the prophets. Our treatment of people is tied to the love God showed by sending His Son, emphasizing that genuine care and compassion flow from faith in Christ. Believers are called to empathize deeply with others, rejoicing in their joys and mourning in their sorrows, demonstrating Christlike fellowship and kindness. Ultimately, the way we treat others will be accounted for when Christ returns in glory, underscoring the eternal significance of our daily interactions.
